title: Large component is hard to read and change
message: Component "BulkDocumentRequestsDialog" is over 300 lines long, which is hard to read & change. Split it into a few smaller components.
help: Pull each section into its own component so the parent is easier to read, test, and change.

title: React Compiler doesn't support this syntax
message: This component misses React Compiler's automatic memoization & re-renders more than it should. Rewrite the flagged code so the compiler can optimize it.
help: Todo: (BuildHIR::lowerStatement) Handle TryStatement with a finalizer ('finally') clause

title: Duplicated JSX structure
message: 3 copies of this 6-node JSX tree appear across 3 files, repeating about 40 lines. Composition path: BulkDocumentRequestsDialog > ActionPanel > ActionPanelContent > form > ActionPanelBody > fieldset > form.Field > TFormItem.
help: Consider extracting a shared component if these trees represent the same UI concept. Keep them separate when the resemblance is incidental or the variants are likely to evolve independently.

title: React function has high control-flow complexity
message: `DocumentRequestsWorkspace` has cyclomatic complexity 26, cognitive complexity 23, and maximum nesting depth 3, so its React logic is hard to understand and change. Extract independent branches into components or hooks.
help: Extract independent render branches and state logic into focused components or hooks until the control flow is easy to follow.

title: Non-component export in component file
message: This file exports non-components, so Fast Refresh can't safely preserve component state.
help: Move non-component exports out of component files so Fast Refresh can preserve component state instead of full-reloading.
